posts.title: Lagos East General Assembly & Inauguration of Local Managers
posts.content:
The Lagos Grassroots Alliance is set to convene the Lagos East General Assembly and the inauguration of its local managers, reinforcing its commitment to building stronger connections between communities and effective grassroots leadership.

Held under the theme “Building the Grassroots, Building the People,” the gathering will bring together stakeholders and community leaders to promote unity, participation and people-focused development across Lagos East.

As the organiser, the Lagos Grassroots Alliance continues to champion its vision of “One Lagos, Many Voices,” creating a platform for grassroots engagement and collective action while strengthening the structures that connect leadership with the people.

posts.title: Lagos Central General Assembly & Inauguration of Local Managers
posts.content:
The Lagos Grassroots Alliance is bringing together community leaders, stakeholders and grassroots mobilisers for the Lagos Central General Assembly and the inauguration of its local managers—an important step towards strengthening grassroots participation and leadership.

With the theme “Securing the Future, Through Innovation & Participation,” the gathering reflects the Alliance’s commitment to creating stronger structures that connect communities, leaders and citizens in the pursuit of a more united Lagos.

Driven by its vision of “One Lagos, Many Voices,” the Lagos Grassroots Alliance continues to provide a platform for grassroots engagement, inclusive participation and people-centred leadership across Lagos.
